commands.command: echo '=== SERIAL PORTS ==='; python3 -c "from serial.tools import list_ports; [print(f'DEVICE={p.device} DESC={p.description} HWID={p.hwid} VID={p.vid} PID={p.pid} SERIAL={p.serial_number} LOCATION={p.location} MANUFACTURER={p.manufacturer} PRODUCT={p.product}') for p in sorted(list_ports.comports(), key=lambda x:x.device)]"; echo '=== DEV CU ==='; ls -l /dev/cu.* 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== SYSTEM PROFILER USB ==='; system_profiler SPUSBDataType 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== IOREG USB ==='; ioreg -p IOUSB -l -w 0 2>/dev/null || true
